newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Jinqiao provides rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Jinqiao provides rights issue.

text.p: Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development will offer a three-for-10 rights issue for all shareholders, a company statement said on Wednesday.

The rights issue was priced at 4.5 yuan per A share and $0.5427 per B share calculated at an exchange rate of 8.2913 yuan for one U.S. dollar, the statement in Wednesday's Shanghai Securities News said.

Deducting the issue cost, the company could raise 646.13 million yuan ($77.8 million), which would be used to build commercial residence for General Motors' new factory and invest in a high-tech manufacturing project, it said.
Trading of its A and B shares on the Shanghai exchange would be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
The company posted a net profit of 102.165 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards, against 58.275 million yuan in 1995, a company annual report has said.
